title: The aadhaar (targeted delivery of financial and other subsidies, benefits and services) act, 2016.
full_text: The aadhaar (targeted delivery of financial and other subsidies, benefits and services) act, 2016. null Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201618 Act Number: 18 Enactment Date: 2016-03-25 Act Year: 2016 Short Title: The aadhaar (targeted delivery of financial and other subsidies, benefits and services) act, 2016. Long Title: An Act to provide for, as a good governance, efficient, transparent, and targeted delivery of subsidies, benefits and services, the expenditure for which is incurred from the Consolidated Fund of India, to individuals residing in India through assigning of unique identity numbers to such individuals and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
